data: What is the approximate value of the orange marker when the blue line is at its lowest point?

The orange markers represent the empirical computational time, while the blue line represents the theoretical computational time. The question asks for the approximate value of the orange marker when the blue line is at its lowest point. From the figure, the blue line reaches its lowest point around the x-axis value of 10^4, and the corresponding orange marker is approximately at 30 ms. Therefore, the approximate value of the orange marker when the blue line is at its lowest point is 30 ms.
